host.title: Host
host.description: The host name, optionally followed by a path, that this IdP answers on, or __DEFAULT__ for any host no other hosted IdP claims.

next_key.title: Next key
next_key.description: Published in the metadata beside the current certificate until it is promoted.

https_certificate.title: Certificate of the HTTPS server
https_certificate.description: Published for artifact resolution and holder-of-key.

SingleSignOnService.title: Single sign-on service
SingleSignOnService.description: Not set: the HTTP-Redirect binding at the address SimpleSAMLphp derives.

SingleLogoutService.title: Single logout service
SingleLogoutService.description: Not set: the HTTP-Redirect binding at the address SimpleSAMLphp derives.

assertion.lifetime.title: Assertion lifetime in seconds
assertion.lifetime.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: 300.

errorURL.title: Error page URL
errorURL.description: Published as the errorURL of the IdP.

attributes.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: every attribute.

attributesRegex.title: Attributes released, as regular expressions
attributesRegex.description: One per line. Applied only when the core:AttributeLimit filter runs.

attributeencodings.description: The SP's encodings are merged over these, attribute by attribute.

attributes.NameFormat.title: Attribute name format
attributes.NameFormat.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: the URI format.

NameIDFormat.title: NameID formats
NameIDFormat.description: One per line; the first is issued when the SP names none. Not set: transient.

nameid.encryption.title: Encrypt the NameID
nameid.encryption.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: off.

saml20.sign.assertion.title: Sign the assertion
saml20.sign.assertion.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: on.

saml20.sign.response.title: Sign the response
saml20.sign.response.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: on.

signature.algorithm.title: Signature algorithm
signature.algorithm.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: RSA-SHA256.

sign.logout.title: Sign logout messages
sign.logout.description: This value wins over the SP's. Not set here or there: the redirect signing option.

redirect.sign.title: Sign messages sent with the redirect binding
redirect.sign.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: off.

validate.authnrequest.title: Validate the signature of authentication requests
validate.authnrequest.description: Published as WantAuthnRequestsSigned. The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: redirect validation; a signature that is present is still checked. Off: never checked, even when present.

validate.logout.title: Validate the signature of logout messages
validate.logout.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: redirect validation; a signature that is present is still checked. Off: never checked, even when present.

redirect.validate.title: Require signatures on the redirect binding
redirect.validate.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: off.

assertion.encryption.title: Encrypt assertions
assertion.encryption.description: The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: off.

encryption.optional.title: Send unencrypted when the SP has no encryption certificate

sharedkey_algorithm.title: Shared key algorithm
sharedkey_algorithm.description: Used only for an SP with a shared key. The SP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: AES128-GCM.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: The technical contact of config.php is added to these.

scope.title: Scopes
scope.description: One per line. A value with any of $ ^ ( ) * | \ is published as a regular expression.

metadata.sign.algorithm.title: Metadata signature algorithm
metadata.sign.algorithm.description: Not set: metadata.sign.algorithm of config.php, then RSA-SHA256.

metadata_sign_key.title: Metadata signing key
metadata_sign_key.description: Not set: the metadata signing key of config.php, then the signing key.

authproc.title: Processing filters
authproc.description: Merged with authproc.idp of config.php and the SP's filters, ordered by priority.
